observed_facts: WorkerBridgeBootstrapper currently consumes exactly 7 CLI arguments (self7) for its own admission receipt and admits role 'SIMULATION'.
WorkerBridgeComponent holds only _activeAdmissionReceipt and _activeStartupConfig for itself; it has no slot for a child admission receipt.

HandleLaunchOperatorValidator currently reads executable path and working directory from parent _activeStartupConfig and launches child process with '--task-file ... --nonce ...' without operator bootstrap arguments.

If child RimWorld process is launched without 7 operator CLI flags, its own WorkerBridgeBootstrapper aborts startup with fail-closed warning/errors ('Missing required -operatorconfig CLI argument... Component will NOT attach').
GenCommandLine.TryGetCommandLineArg in Assembly-CSharp requires '-key=value' format with an '=' delimiter and split length exactly 2.
GenFilePaths.get_SaveDataFolderPath in Assembly-CSharp natively reads '-savedatafolder=<path>' and overrides save data root early in initialization.
OperatorChildLaunchInputs.Capture (R27) requires parent admission receipt ('SIMULATION'), child admission receipt ('READ_ONLY'), task, and taskFilePath to construct the immutable container.
Dedicated server (WarEconomyMod/Source/Server/Program.cs) does not produce operator configurations, launch worker processes, or manage child validator lifecycles.
identified_missing_elements: No operator-owned producer exists in live code to generate, sign, or supply a paired READ_ONLY child configuration to the primary simulation worker.
No mechanism exists in WorkerBridgeBootstrapper to admit or store a paired child startup receipt alongside the parent simulation receipt.
HandleLaunchOperatorValidator does not invoke OperatorChildLaunchInputs.Capture and does not supply the 7 operator CLI flags to the child process.
proposed_boundaries: Establish an explicit operator-owned startup pair carrier at worker bootstrap: primary worker CLI accepts both self7 (SIMULATION) and child7 (READ_ONLY).
Admit child startup configuration at bootstrap using OperatorStartupConfigAdmissionFactory.IssueAdmissionReceipt, strictly verifying role == 'READ_ONLY'.
Store paired child receipt in a private static slot in WorkerBridgeComponent (_pairedChildAdmissionReceipt) inaccessible to public TCP requesters or global setters.

Consume paired child receipt inside HandleLaunchOperatorValidator via OperatorChildLaunchInputs.Capture(_activeAdmissionReceipt, _pairedChildAdmissionReceipt, currentValidatorTask, currentValidatorTaskPath).
Format child process CLI using exact 7 operator option values (-operatorconfig=..., etc.) and -savedatafolder="{SelectedUserDataDirectory}" per frozen ECMA335 IL requirements.

recommended_route.rationale: Reuses existing canonical 7-field descriptor without inventing new external wire protocols, dynamic TCP commands, or PKI schemas. Guarantees immutable custody from the exact moment of bootstrap, eliminates post-Awake race conditions, and natively satisfies frozen RimWorld CLI parsers.

lifecycle_sequence.details: Operator generates parent config (SIMULATION) and child config (READ_ONLY). Emits primary RimWorld command line containing parent 7 args (-operatorconfig=..., -operatorrole=SIMULATION, etc.) and paired child 7 args (-childoperatorconfig=..., -childoperatorrole=READ_ONLY, etc.).

Parses parent 7 args -> issues parent receipt (asserts Role == 'SIMULATION'). Parses child 7 args -> issues child receipt (asserts Role == 'READ_ONLY'). Installs both into WorkerBridgeComponent.TryInstallOperatorStartupConfig(parentReceipt, childReceipt).
Verifies parent receipt valid. Verifies paired child receipt present and valid (or marks validation-launch capability disabled). Starts TCP listener.
Dedicated server / test coordinator requests task preparation. WorkerBridgeComponent issues ValidatorTask (generating MD126 unguessable capabilityNonce) and writes task file.

Verifies capabilityNonce matches currentValidatorTask. Invokes OperatorChildLaunchInputs.Capture(_activeAdmissionReceipt, _pairedChildAdmissionReceipt, currentValidatorTask, currentValidatorTaskPath). Reads 15 getters for all process start parameters.

FileName = launchInputs.ExecutablePath. WorkingDirectory = launchInputs.WorkingDirectory. Arguments = 7 child operator flags in -key=value format + -savedatafolder="{launchInputs.SelectedUserDataDirectory}" + --task-file="{launchInputs.TaskFilePath}" + --nonce="{capabilityNonce}". Uses Process.Start(psi).

Vanilla GenFilePaths overrides save data root to launchInputs.SelectedUserDataDirectory. Child WorkerBridgeBootstrapper admits itself cleanly as READ_ONLY using its 7 CLI args. Child component listens on its designated port and executes the task in complete isolation.
